ThingDef.label: fallen TIE wing panel
ThingDef.description: A hexagonal solar wing panel torn off a TIE starfighter on the way down, its collector cells cracked, the strut stub still bolted to one edge. It came down recently; the scorch is fresh and nothing has been taken. Deconstruct it for valuable resources.

ThingDef.label: crashed landspeeder
ThingDef.description: An open-cockpit landspeeder that lost its repulsors and ploughed into the ground nose first. One turbine is crumpled, the windscreen is gone, and the seat padding is still smoking. Deconstruct it for valuable resources.
